label: Aurora Card
css: #dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"]{background:radial-gradient(80% 70% at 50% 110%,#12324a 0%,#070b12 62%);color:#e8f4ff}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"] .aurora-sky{position:absolute;inset:0}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"] .aurora-canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"] .aurora-card{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:38cqw;height:72cqh;transform:translate(-50%,-46%) scale(.92);opacity:0;border-radius:2.2cqh;overflow:hidden;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--secondary) 18%,#061018);box-shadow:0 2cqh 8cqh rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 0 4cqh color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 35%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary) 45%,#fff)}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"].on .aurora-card{animation:aurora-rise .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) forwards}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"].off .aurora-card{opacity:0;transition:opacity .28s ease,transform .28s ease;transform:translate(-50%,-40%) scale(.96)}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"] .aurora-card img{width:100%;height:62%;object-fit:cover;background:#123}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"] .aurora-copy{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:38%;padding:2.4cqh 2.6cqw 2cqh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:1cqh;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(6,10,16,.88) 28%)}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"] .aurora-msg{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif;font-style:italic;line-height:1.2}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"] .aurora-msg span{display:block}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="example-aurora"] .aurora-name{height:4.2cqh;overflow:hidden;font-family:Outfit,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--primary);font-size:1.8cqh}@keyframes aurora-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-40%) scale(.92)}to{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-46%) scale(1)}}
